acceptanceCriteria: For schema-v3, preserve the provider-reported base in raw identity bindings while deriving the actual base from M1 first parent; require exactly two M1 parents in exact order [actualBase,H1], correct H1 identity, provider-base ancestry, clean merge-tree equality, and docs absence checks including actualBase.

Positive end-to-end receipt-path regression uses M1 37cc4e540ce23a721382d9c6b510218dc5ba69c1 with actual first parent 508a0a0f47dcbb957aacb8b03220f6234a87549d, H1 d18be4f8624d08f91fe1c961dfed287cfe9543df, and provider raw base d1a731570fb0af2ee5142e13b5d7cf9a7d4b0b50; the provider base differs from the actual first parent but is its ancestor.

Negative end-to-end cases reject wrong parent count/order/head, a non-ancestor provider base, merge conflict or tampered tree, tampered provider raw-base identity, and required-absent docs found at actualBase.
Existing v1/v2 behavior and boundary tests remain unchanged; no v1/v2 migration or receipt/schema change.
